  WHERE ('thousands' = ?)
  ORDER BY  2  DESC),
cte_1 AS (  SELECT 'units' "orders__amount_unit", "orders".AMOUNT "orders__revenue" 
  FROM  DWH_TESTING.RECON_DEMO.ORDERS  AS "orders"
  WHERE ('units' = ?)
  ORDER BY  2  DESC),

  FROM  cte_0  AS "q_l"
  FULL JOIN  cte_1  AS "q_r" ON (("q_l"."orders__amount_unit" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "q_r"."orders__amount_unit"))) AS "full_aggregate")

  DAYNAME(d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS DAY_NAME,
  DAYOFWEEKISO(d.CALENDAR_DATE) >= 6 AS IS_WEEKEND
FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD('day', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) - 1, '2024-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS CALENDAR_DATE
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 1461))
) AS d
)  AS "calendar" ON CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', DATE_TRUNC('day', "orders".ORDERED_AT)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ::timestamp_tz)::timestamp_ntz = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', "calendar".CALENDAR_DATE::timestamp_tz)::timestamp_ntz
ORDER BY  1  ASC
LIMIT 1
